cases.name: batch with two fees on the same account, rounding and skipped rows
cases.detail: contas: 1 row(s) only in the original e.g. {"agencia": "0001", "cliente_id": "1", "data_abertura": "2025-01-10T00:00:00", "numero": "10-1", "saldo": "993.99", "status": "ATIVA", "tipo": "CORRENTE"} 1 only in the generated e.g. {"agencia": "0001", "cliente_id": "1", "data_abertura": "2025-01-10T00:00:00", "numero": "10-1", "saldo": "994", "status": "ATIVA", "tipo": "CORRENTE"}; transacoes: 1 row(s) only in the original e.g. {"conta_destino_id": null, "conta_origem_id": "10", "status": "EFETIVADA", "tipo": "TARIFA", "valor": "5.01"} 1 only in the generated e.g. {"conta_destino_id": null, "conta_origem_id": "10", "status": "EFETIVADA", "tipo": "TARIFA", "valor": "5"}; log_auditoria: 2 row(s) only in the original e.g. {"acao": "LOTE_PROCESSADO", "detalhes": {"data_referencia": "2026-09-15", "total_taxas": "6.46", "transacoes": "3"}, "entidade": "lote_taxas", "entidade_id": null} 2 only in the generated e.g. {"acao": "LOTE_PROCESSADO", "detalhes": {"data_referencia": "2026-09-15", "total_taxas": "6.4495", "transacoes": "3"}, "entidade": "lote_taxas", "entidade_id": null}
